description: This Java class 'OrderListState' manages the state of an order list in a web application, including pagination, order status, type, and filters. It provides methods for session management, updating state based on HTTP requests, and retrieving filtered order data from a database.

classes.name: OrderListState
classes.description: A session-scoped class that maintains the state of an order list, including pagination, status filters, order type filters, and methods to retrieve filtered orders from the database.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Retrieves the current user's OrderListState from the session or creates a new one with default values.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the order list state based on HTTP request parameters, handling pagination or status/type/filter changes.

methods.name: changePaginationState
methods.description: Updates view size and index for pagination based on request parameters.

methods.name: changeOrderListStates
methods.description: Updates order status, type, and filter states based on request parameters.

methods.name: getOrderStatusState
methods.description: Returns the current map of order status filters.

methods.name: getOrderTypeState
methods.description: Returns the current map of order type filters.

methods.name: getorderFilterState
methods.description: Returns the current map of order filter states.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the status filter for a given parameter.

methods.name: setType
methods.description: Sets the order type filter for a given parameter.

methods.name: hasStatus
methods.description: Checks if a specific order status filter is active.

methods.name: hasType
methods.description: Checks if a specific order type filter is active.

methods.name: hasFilter
methods.description: Checks if a specific order filter is active.

methods.name: hasAllStatus
methods.description: Checks if all order status filters are active.

methods.name: getViewSize
methods.description: Returns the current pagination view size.

methods.name: getViewIndex
methods.description: Returns the current pagination view index.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the total number of orders in the current filtered set.

methods.name: hasPrevious
methods.description: Indicates if there is a previous page in pagination.

methods.name: hasNext
methods.description: Indicates if there is a next page in pagination.

methods.name: getOrders
methods.description: Retrieves a list of order headers matching current filters and pagination, querying the database.

search-terms: Java class for order list state
